decisions.reason: As a relatively lightly presented extension in a competitive construction-vehicle niche, this product likely fell short of aspiration levels and, given limited evidence of continued commitment, management would reallocate resources to stronger core lines.

This inclined furniture lift fits the firm's lifting and service capabilities well enough that, under uncertainty, management would likely keep it while results remain close to aspiration and organizational slack still permits learning.

Because the inclined building material lift is closely aligned with the firm's construction and lifting customer base, management would likely see it as meeting or approaching aspiration better than adjacent experiments and retain it.

The truck-mounted inclined furniture lift serves a professional niche that can use the firm's engineering and after-sales strengths, so management would likely continue it unless clearer evidence of underperformance emerged.
